## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days or PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days in areas with low G6PD deficient prevalence and poor adherence to 14-day regimen | Strict medical supervision |
| **G6PD deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Only with close medical supervision and access to transfusion services |
| **G6PD severely deficient** | No PQ |  |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | With counselling for adverse events, pharmacovigilance, reinforcement of health services' ability to adequately manage adverse events |
